name: Shitsurae Interiors
description: Shitsurae Interiors is a portfolio and studio theme for interior designers, architects, and bespoke fit-out practices. Designed around high-key documentary photography and structured case studies, it presents finished rooms, transparent budgets, and hand-crafted material details with calm clarity. Built with block patterns, responsive typography, and full site editing support, it delivers an unhurried, tactile editorial experience.
